Rationale for Preparation of the Resettlement Framework

World Bank policy requires "screening" of all projects proposed for Bank financing to help

ensure that they take social concerns into account with respect to adverse impacts on project

affected people (PAP's) and to appropriately plan for and respond to these impacts, and thus

improve decision making about resettlement, options, alternatives, participation of PAP's and
